t: Forking a Flake of Infrastructure as Code
s: The article details how to create a portable, reproducible development environment by forking a Nix Flake from Pipulate. It emphasizes leveraging timeless Linux foundations and flexible data science workflows with tools like Nix, Python virtual environments, JupyterLab, and AI editors.
sub: Creating a reproducible Python development environment with Nix Flakes.
Porting Pipulate infrastructure code (Nix Flake) to a new project (botifython).
Integrating AI coding assistance (Cursor AI, Jupyter AI) with local LLMs (Ollama) via Nix-managed environments.
Bridging local development workflows (Linux) with cross-platform compatibility (Mac) using Git and SSH.
Managing Python dependencies with `requirements.txt` for reproducible data science.
